incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: mu opened, but its local service cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart mu.

incompleteInstallation.title: mu installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so mu's local service cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest mu. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined mu's files.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest mu package. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined mu components.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: mu package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This mu package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: mu opened, but its local service stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling mu may not fix this. The app log shows where the local database migration stopped.

databaseNewerThanApp.title: A newer version of mu is required
databaseNewerThanApp.description: Your local data was created by a newer version of mu, and this version can't open it. Update mu to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.
databaseNewerThanApp.descriptionWithVersion: Your local data was created by a version of mu newer than the one installed now (v{{currentVersion}}), so this version can't open it. Update mu to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: mu opened, but its local service stopped while preparing local startup data such as assistant or agent records. Reinstalling mu may not fix this. The app log shows which local data could not be prepared.

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: mu opened, but its local service could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart mu.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: mu detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, mu will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Past conversations will no longer be shown, and the old database will be kept as a backup file.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

confirmDialog.title: Rebuild the database?
confirmDialog.content: This will back up the currently corrupted database and create a brand-new empty one. Past conversations will no longer be shown (the old database is kept as a backup file). Continue?

transientConcurrentStartup.title: mu is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another mu startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart mu.

pendingSlow.title: Starting up
pendingSlow.description: The local service is starting up, please wait. If it doesn't respond after a while, you can quit and reopen the app.

exited.title: Startup didn't complete
exited.description: The local service couldn't finish starting and has exited. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, check the app log.

portReportTimeout.title: Startup timed out
portReportTimeout.description: The local service didn't finish starting within the expected time. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, check the app log.

startupFailed.title: Startup failed
startupFailed.description: The local service failed to start. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, check the app log.

hints.answered: This message answers the agent’s own question: act on it and do not ask again.
hints.resolve: The request is loosely worded and may change files: look at the project, state the assumption, and ask only for what cannot be found here.
hints.clarify: The request looks under-specified: ask one focused question first.
hints.side_question: This is a side question: answer it briefly, then carry on with the main task.
hints.plan_first: This looks large or risky: write a short plan, then carry it out; pause only before a step that cannot be undone.
hints.try_hive: This looks hard: if the cause is unknown or a direct attempt fails, use the Hive.
hints.try_delegate: This splits into independent parts: consider handing them to sub-agents in parallel.

understand.title: Understand this project

fix.title: Find and fix a problem

plan.title: Plan a change

plan.prompt: I want to build: <describe what you need>. Give me an implementation plan and the files involved first, and start editing only after I confirm.
